html:
A singer born in Ouidah who left Benin for Paris in 1983 to escape the restrictions of Kerekou's regime and became one of the leading voices of African music worldwide.

Her songs mix the rhythms of Benin and Vodun with funk, jazz and pop, and she has sung in Fon, Yoruba, French and English. Her recordings have won several Grammy awards, and she has covered and reworked music from across Africa and its diaspora. She is a UNICEF goodwill ambassador and campaigns for girls' education. See also Fela Kuti.
